bless-you/a-new-york-home.description: A rectangular yellow light brightens and fades behind a house at dusk.
bless-you/a-new-york-home.excerpt:
This is an invisible home.
In the city, it stands briefly,

bless-you/behind-my-mind.description: Aurora curtains rippling over a still fjord, a cabin lit on the shore.
bless-you/behind-my-mind.excerpt:
Still, you wave from where you stand,
Your eyes fixed past me, their light no longer gleams.

bless-you/beloved.description: A golden silhouette, with a point of light at the heart that blooms and recedes.
bless-you/beloved.excerpt:
The lingering love,
flowing endlessly where hope slowly descends.

bless-you/crown-antiques.description: Dusty antique-shop glazing, blue-green square tiles, stacked records and boxes; motes fall through light on both sides of the glass.

bless-you/cube.excerpt:
Your faltering faith.
You preach self-sacrifice, for others to change to triangles.

bless-you/dancing-children.description: Dusk aarti on the ganga, lamps on the steps and diyas on the water.
bless-you/dancing-children.excerpt:
Squares, tiles, branches, broken leaves,
Dancing between lines,

bless-you/drowned-spirit.description: An empty riverside bench, rippling city reflections and a fading sunset; blue hour arrives as window and shore lights gradually brighten.
bless-you/drowned-spirit.excerpt:
At the bottom of the river, you,
Were replaced by someone's spirit.

bless-you/ears.description: A tokyo side street in the rain, neon signs shining on the wet road.
bless-you/ears.excerpt:
Skin brushing against plastic, then the luminous floor,
Gray spots pulsing, dancing along familiar streets, across length.

bless-you/feet.description: Snow peaks catching first light above a still, misty mountain lake.
bless-you/feet.excerpt:
Replacing street lights' gleam,
In bridge tunnels where snow convince.

bless-you/flying-away.description: The sun sinks into a drifting sea of orange cloud at dusk.
bless-you/flying-away.excerpt: While we remain, on earth by day and night,

bless-you/gentleness.description: Dusk aarti on the ganga, lamps on the steps and diyas on the water.
bless-you/gentleness.excerpt:
A gentle breeze comes softly, brushing past my ears,
It brings sunlight, filtering through my eyes.

bless-you/how.description: Sunset on lake pichola, udaipur's palaces glowing over the water.
bless-you/how.excerpt:
The heart's pulse, emotions flowing,
Watching sunlight reflect on waves.

bless-you/in-the-sunlight.description: The earth rising over a cratered lunar horizon in long low sunlight.
bless-you/in-the-sunlight.excerpt:
Awaiting sunlight's touch, where children stay and play.
Shadows retreat as moments hold their way,

bless-you/kite.description: Pine ridges fading into morning fog, sunbeams slanting through.
bless-you/kite.excerpt:
Your figure shows then fade,
During the night.

bless-you/milk-cow-cat.description: The sun sets past a pine headland, lit cloud, glitter on rolling sea.
bless-you/milk-cow-cat.excerpt:
Is it the wild wind that whispers verse and rhyme,
Or earth's rich soil that clothes you through all time?

bless-you/missing.description: Saturn and its rings hanging over the cracked ice and geysers of a moon.
bless-you/missing.excerpt:
Round domes, Roman style,
Surrounded by rock, infused with faith,

bless-you/perplexity.excerpt:
Telling children tales of skies up high to the hill.
"Will I become a cloud when I am gone?"

bless-you/river.description: The taj mahal at sunrise, mirrored in its pool through morning haze.
bless-you/river.excerpt:
Within the pen, You are ever mine.
Dream a diver, on a noiseless land,

bless-you/silver-tipped-shoes.description: Silver snow ridges and one sharp ice facet rise over a dark blue mirror lake under a pale moon.
bless-you/silver-tipped-shoes.excerpt:
Silver-tipped shoes, shiny and bright,
Catch my eyes with their gleaming light.

bless-you/symphony.description: Moonlight glints on a quiet river below a stone bridge, between shadowed trees and distant houses.
bless-you/symphony.excerpt:
Walking through the night,
Listening to symphonies played by moonlight.

bless-you/telecine.description: The vercel triangle over a mirror of salt, the sun rising behind its tip.
bless-you/telecine.excerpt:
Unable to pick up flowers and wine,
The pen I put down now turns into your food.

bless-you/the-absurd.description: The sun sets past a pine headland, lit cloud, glitter on rolling sea.
bless-you/the-absurd.excerpt:
Dancing, she dances, is the absurd, the absurd and more,
Like clouds your polished mind changes shape forevermore.

bless-you/the-only.description: A wall of lava lamps under the glowing orange cloud, watched by a camera.

bless-you/today.excerpt:
While shrimp floats in the sink below,
just a fork needed till dawn's light is thrown.

bless-you/traces-of-healing.description: Light shafts, swaying kelp and a turning school of fish over a reef.

Lingering between the broken steps of the church,

Rain and people were both tangled in the moon.

And snow beyond the window's frosted pane.

I woke to the aroma of dinner,

still-life/coin.description: The sun sinks into a drifting sea of orange cloud at dusk.
still-life/coin.excerpt:
Consciousness slips past sunlight and smile,
I gaze upon your face,

A blue light enters, tinged with pink and orange hues.

playing on the shelves, faded yet stayed.

I nodded, then made myself a cup of hot tea,

weeping in the sunny day, where

In lethargy all seems asleep.
The train dormant at its station,

still-life/snowy-county.description: Snow peaks catching first light above a still, misty mountain lake.

As I walk past, it is white, snowy.
Into every corner of sight,

Until my tears stopped the smile,

At five, I get up from the boat, washing;
Seven, washing, waking up, washing.

Together on grass, beneath the snow.
Missing you and summer's gentle glow,

On the plate, yellow eggs, green avocados,

I, therefore, should begin to say goodbye.

Watching me go home, go to school,

Standing here, watching the still, delicate blue sky.

Idle soul, drifting without purpose,

their-world/side.description: Sunset on lake pichola, udaipur's palaces glowing over the water.
their-world/side.excerpt:

their-world/siren.excerpt:

Or scorched by relentless sun until all living traces vanish.

their-world/umbrella.description: A tokyo side street in the rain, neon signs shining on the wet road.

their-world/window.description: A wall of lava lamps under the glowing orange cloud, watched by a camera.
their-world/window.excerpt:
